prompt: A monastery on a floating island, reached by a long stair.

card.name: Stair Monastery

site.text: a floating island, reached by a long stair

style.text: serene, quiet stone cloister in the sky; pale stone, weathered wood, lanterns, hanging greenery

card.interpretation: A monastery (purpose) set on a floating island (custom-shaped sky island, sculpted since it doesn't exist naturally). The long stair is part of the site, rising to a gatehouse at the island's edge. I read the style as a calm, pale-stone cloister in the sky, and the program is a chapel, cells, refectory, scriptorium, garden and observatory.
assumptions: Size M, low density for a quiet monastery.
Style not specified; assumed a serene pale-stone cloister look.
The long stair rises from the ground below to the gatehouse.
No backstory given, so none added.

program.notes: Main church at the island's heart with a bell tower and tall windows open to the sky.
Where the long stair arrives on the island; the monastery's only entrance.
Small plain sleeping cells arranged around a cloister.
Dining hall and kitchen with a long table.
Walled garden with crops and flowers, tended by the monks.
Open-topped lookout on the highest point of the island.
